≈1–2 hours of travel (if you use Lai's clues, she takes a few days to reveal them)

{npc:Lai}, in Azzilon Castle, tells the legend of an adventurer who stole a fragment of the crystal of a Merudri guardian statue and hid the pieces of its miniature in three sanctuaries around the world. Find the three fragments — in Nibelor, in Zao and in Kilmaresh — and combine them with the crystal fragments on top of a rock in Kha'zeel to assemble the {item:Guardian Statue (Quest)}.
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 250** (you pass through areas with strong creatures, such as Burning Gladiators and Massive Energy Elementals).
{wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} done up to the mission *Cure the Dogs* (Nibelor 5), so you have access to {wiki:Inukaya}.
{wiki:The New Frontier Quest} done up to the mission *An Offer You Can't Refuse* (mission 8), so you have access to the {wiki:Muggy Plains}.
Optional: access to {wiki:Azzilon Castle} ({wiki:No Rest for the Wicked Quest}) to talk to Lai. It is possible to do the quest without going to Azzilon or talking to her.
Spell {spell:Levitate} (you climb mountains and platforms in Inukaya, Kilmaresh and Kha'zeel).
to use the sled to Inukaya and back
or a Pick: Lai warns that there are cracks in the rock in Kha'zeel
You do not need to wait for Lai's hints: with this guide you can go straight to the three shrines.
Bring at least 2 {item:Ham|Hams}: you need them in your backpack to go to and from Inukaya by sled.
This step is optional, but it unlocks Lai's hints and the story of the quest.

Go to **Edron** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain of your city) and enter the teleport to {wiki:Azzilon Castle} (it only works if you have access through the {wiki:No Rest for the Wicked Quest}). Talk to {npc:Lai}: {key:hi}, {key:statue}, {key:legend} and {key:yes}. She tells you the secret of the Merudri valley and the legend of the intruder who saw a pilgrim use a statue of three dragons holding a crystal to travel to the valley. To help you, she will channel the Dhar-Enpa Udra, which takes a few days.

Whenever you want a new hint, ask Lai about {key:fragment of a statue}. She gradually reveals where the three shrines are and, in the end, where the crystal fragments are. To return to Edron, leave the castle the same way you came in.

Go to **Svargrond** by boat (for example from Thais, Carlin or Venore: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Breezelda}. Go to the ice area **north/northeast** of the city and talk to {npc:Iskan}, the owner of the dog sled: {key:hi}, {key:passage}. He takes you to the island of {wiki:Nibelor}.
Go to **Nibelor** and use the sled to reach the eastern part of the island, {wiki:Inukaya}. You must have {item:Ham|Hams} in your backpack to go and return.
Walk a bit further **east** and use {spell:Levitate} to climb this mountain **twice**.
At the top, use the shrine and you find the {item:Fragment of a Statue (1st)|first statue fragment}.

Go down the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (downwards) in the same two spots where you went up and head back **west** to the sled. Use it again (the dogs eat another {item:Ham}) to return to Nibelor. In Nibelor, talk to {npc:Nilsor}, **west** of the stone circle: {key:hi}, {key:passage}. He takes you back to **Svargrond**.
If you run out of {item:Ham} in Inukaya, the dogs will not take you back. Always bring an extra one.

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, in {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}. In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain. Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe}. In the **north** of the steppe, south of the Dragonblaze Peaks, use the old lizard teleport to the {wiki:Muggy Plains} (it only works after mission 8 of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}).
Mountain exit to the Zao Steppe
Climbing the stairs in the Muggy Plains
Go to the {wiki:Muggy Plains}, in **Zao** (Lai describes a green area, with insects, heat, bamboo and grass). Climb the stairs at this spot.
Use the shrine and you find the {item:Fragment of a Statue (2nd)|second statue fragment}.

Go down the stairs and return the same way: lizard teleport to the Zao steppe, mountain (climb up with {spell:Levitate} where you came down) and elevator to Farmine. At Farmine harbour, talk to {npc:Thorgrin}: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}.

The Southern Steppe is in {wiki:Kilmaresh}, the island whose capital is **Issavi**. There are boats to Issavi in **Venore**, **Darashia**, **Krailos** and **Oramond** ({key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Captain Harava}'s boat, at the harbour in the **north** of the city. Alternatively, come by flying carpet and you arrive at {npc:Tanyt}'s platform. From the city, head **south** to the Southern Steppe.
Climbing the stairs on the Southern Steppe
Go to the Southern Steppe, in **Kilmaresh** (dry area, with rocks, cliffs and a big river). Climb the stairs at this spot.
Levitating to the platform and using the shrine
Use {spell:Levitate} to climb to a platform **west** of the NPC {npc:Tefrit}. Use the shrine and you find the {item:Fragment of a Statue (3rd)|third statue fragment}.

Come down from the platform with {spell:Levitate} (downwards) and go down the stairs. Head back **north** to Issavi and, at the harbour, talk to {npc:Captain Harava}: {key:hi}, the destination ({key:darashia}, {key:venore}, {key:krailos} or {key:oramond}) and {key:yes}. You can also use {npc:Tanyt}'s flying carpet.
With the three pieces, all that is left is to find the crystal fragments of the original statue, on top of a rock at the foot of the Kha'zeel mountains.

If you ask {npc:Lai} about {key:fragment of a statue} after you have the three pieces, she congratulates you and tells you where the original statue was. She warns that there are cracks in the rock: bring a {item:Shovel} or {item:Pick}.
Climbing the mountains west of Ankrahmun

Go to **Ankrahmun** by boat (for example from Darashia, Venore, Edron, Liberty Bay or Port Hope: {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}). In the desert near the city, use {spell:Levitate} to climb the mountains to the **west**, where there are {creature:Energy Elemental|Energy Elementals}: first at the first spot and then at the second.
Walk a little to the **north** and use {spell:Levitate} one last time.
Use one of the three statue pieces you have in your backpack on the crystal fragments lying on the ground. The {item:Guardian Statue (Quest)} is assembled.
Crystal fragments on top of the rock
Coming down from the Kha'zeel mountains
To return, go down with {spell:Levitate} (downwards) in the same three spots where you went up, in reverse order, and head back to Ankrahmun through the desert.
If you ask {npc:Lai} about {key:fragment of a statue} again, she remarks that you have rebuilt the guardian statue and that it may be time to invite strangers to the valley.
Lai says the statue "has no real purpose" for the Merudri; the quest is mostly a hunt for fragments for the sake of the valley's story.
Fragment locations: 1st in Nibelor (Inukaya), 2nd in Zao (Muggy Plains), 3rd in Kilmaresh (Southern Steppe); crystal in Kha'zeel.
